title: Composed normative assurance kernel v2
authority_path: usable evidence witnesses plus defeater disposition
rules: A component listed as normative is not a forcing barrier until it is actually composed into the single authority path.
Any kernel-level violation downgrades an otherwise PASS terminal status to UNKNOWN.
Witness roots must exist in the declared support graph and may not themselves be claim nodes.
Stale dependency snapshots block current authority.
Missing primitive trust roots block authority.
invariants: Authority Is The Intersection Of All Active Kernel Obligations
A PASS certificate is reusable only while its support graph, trust roots and dependencies remain current
boundary: Kernel v2 enforces structural assurance obligations. It still depends on correct claim typing and correct declaration of support/trust/dependency metadata, which are attacked in subsequent contracts.
